Public Ok entails two ordered successful complete flush certificates, full first/second barrier-time byte evidence and drained final pending stripes. Current physical modeled image equality is conditional on every intervening frame gate passing; no native callback inertness is inferred.

Arbitrary valid images, finite valid pending stripes and independent complete headers reach actual B public Ok under successful decisions; an actual B PC35 Err after publication preserves both barrier history and modeled bytes. Native objects, branches, geometry/ownership/resource admission, backend byte/crash laws, callbacks, concurrency, abnormal paths and complete native adapter R are not bound by this product. Equal events or bytes do not establish R. No producer/trust adoption or final-cell promotion.
